title: Maze Solver
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Maze
learningObjectives: Explain how breadth-first search uses a queue to expand the frontier one step at a time from the maze entrance
Distinguish the queue-based frontier of the solver from the stack-based backtracking used to generate the maze
Trace how each visited cell records its predecessor so the shortest path can be reconstructed once the exit is reached
Predict how the solve-speed slider changes the animation rate without changing the path BFS finds
Compare the paths found across several New Maze layouts to explain why BFS always returns a shortest route
